bitcoin_articles.headline: MARA Holdings, Inc. Sells 13,597 Bitcoin and Repays $750 Million in Debt
bitcoin_articles.summary: MARA Holdings, Inc. executed a significant capital allocation move by selling 13,597 Bitcoin to retire $750 million in debt.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Strive, Inc. Updates Bitcoin Treasury Holdings
bitcoin_articles.summary: Strive, Inc. (NASDAQ: ASST) has added 29 Bitcoin to its corporate treasury, bringing its total holdings to 43,153 BTC.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Arkham Intelligence Identifies CoinShares' BITC ETP Assets
bitcoin_articles.summary: Arkham Intelligence has updated its platform to label CoinShares' BITC physical Bitcoin ETP as holding approximately $1.52 billion in assets.

bitcoin_articles.headline: CoinShares Physical Bitcoin Digital Securities Admitted to Trading on London Stock Exchange
bitcoin_articles.summary: The London Stock Exchange issued a notice confirming the admission of 15,000 units of CoinShares Physical Bitcoin Digital Securities to trading.
